_format: Review file for grammar rules. Fill it by hand from Taylor's front matter (never from a model). Import with: make import-grammar FILE=path/to/your-file.json. A row is imported only when hand_checked is true.

_fields.label: A short name you choose for the rule or class
_fields.rule: A JSON object holding the rule as you transcribed it. You decide its keys.
_fields.source_page: The page of the source it came from, e.g. 'Taylor 1891, p. N'
_fields.confidence: low, medium or high: how sure you are the OCR text was read correctly
_fields.hand_checked: true only after you have checked the row against the page image
